text:
anya: Heads-up — CloudMart confirmed a joint "launch demo" on their marketplace. We need a concise execution plan: launch blog + marketplace listing, benchmark callouts, 40min webinar + panel, and inbound lead routing mapping. Assigning chunks now.

sam: I can run webinar logistics (host/MC, panel lineup, tech run). Proposed live date: 2026-04-07 morning PT. Is that okay?

anya: That date works for the partner. We have ~10 business days to prepare. Tight but doable.

liz: Ill own the launch post, landing content, and the marketplace listing copy. I need hero benchmark numbers and a one-line partner quote. Also SFDC campaign info for lead mapping.

Tomas: Ill own the benchmark narrative + appendix. Need to lock the demo workload (we recommended embeddings lookup + reranking demo) and the test config. Will coordinate with eng-infra for nodes.

neil: Ill do lead routing and ops wiring (webhook, SFDC mapping, assignment rules). Who is the partner contact for attribution?

anya: Partner contact: paul.c@cloudmart (CloudMart prefers partner_attr=cloudmart_marketplace). Use campaign param cloudmart_marketplace.

liz: Draft hero blurb idea: "Redwood + CloudMart: deploy high-throughput LLM inference via your cloud marketplace — <20ms 99th-pct latency on recommended tiers; 2x cost reduction vs baseline through prefix caching + int8 quantization." Thoughts?

sam: Strong. Webinar format: 10m partner intro, 25m live product demo (Redwood SE + CloudMart PM), 15m panel/customer + 20m audience Q&A. Ill draft run of show and moderator script.

Tomas: For the benchmark, proposal: 10k query corpus, mix 60% instruction / 40% chat prompts, sequence length 512 tokens, evaluate throughput, 95th/99th latencies, and token cost per 1k. Will publish harness and methodology note.

liz: Lead form fields for landing page: name, email, company, role, interest (POC/Trial/Buy), campaign=cloudmart_marketplace, lead_source=cloudmart_demo. Can Ops auto-tag partner and campaign?

neil: Yes. Example payload weld push to the marketing webhook: `{"campaign":"cloudmart_marketplace","lead_source":"marketplace","partner":"CloudMart","origin":"demo_event"}`. SFDC rule: Marketplace leads -> SDR marketplace queue -> tag partner:CloudMart.

anya: Can marketing-bot create a calendar invite and a draft Contentful page?

marketing-bot: Calendar event "CloudMart x Redwood  Demo: Marketplace Launch" created for 2026-04-07 10:00-11:30 PT. Draft page created at /content/cloudmart-launch-demo-draft. Assigned to liz and tomas.

sam: Quick timeline:
- Day 0: confirm date + partner speakers (sam)
- Day 2: landing page draft + lead form (liz)
- Day 3: initial benchmark numbers (tomas)
- Day 5: finalize assets; run perf tests and record clip (infra + tomas)
- Day 7: rehearsal + speaker brief (sam + neil)
- Day 8: email invites live; ads start (liz)
- Day 10: event day; monitor SLOs and have fallback model ready (neil)

liz: Ill drop the landing hero and CTA today. Need bench numbers by EOD Thu for copy.

Tomas: Starting the harness now on A100 q4 config. Expect first-pass numbers in ~36 hours. Will include reproducible commands and a short methodology note.

neil: For runtime fallback: if primary model exceeds latency SLO, route at edge to quantized variant and show a short banner on the demo stream indicating a temporary degradation + fallback engaged. Also prepping a canned statement for comms.

anya: Owners recap: sam (webinar & speakers), liz (landing + launch post + marketplace listing), tomas (benchmark + appendix), neil (lead routing + fallbacks). Ill own partner comms and the email copy.

sam: One request for the launch post: highlight two technical callouts — (1) 99th-pct latency at 512 tokens; (2) cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. Tomas can you provide both with short methodology blurb?

Tomas: Yes. Ill include the harness link and a short reproducibility note: "internal harness; open steps; reproduce on A100 q4."

liz: Ill add a short FAQ for the marketplace listing (billing, supported VM types, data privacy). Drafting now.

marketing-bot: Reminder: tag all Jira stories with #cloudmart-demo.

neil: SFDC rule draft pushed: ops/lead-rules/cloudmart. Webhook configured to push campaign metadata and partner tag.

anya: Next sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If anyone hits blockers ping here. :thumbsup: 

sam: 44d

liz: 44d

Tomas: On it

neil: Monitoring repo for infra outputs

anya: Closing thread unless partner requests changes.
